snippet.title: CRITICAL FAILURE (Cinematic Game Trailer)
snippet.description:
GAME TRAILER FOR "CRITICAL FAILURE"

AVAILABLE ON STEAM 

CRITICAL FAILURE - A sci fi horror series

A story of the zombie apocalypse in the near future were a pharmaceutical company makes a mistake or two leading to the zombie apocalypse outbreak. A tale of survival and a fight to find a cure amongst the chaos, individuals claim factions and try to take over power with their own rules and own order. 

 A show tied directly to video games available for all on STEAM to play along and piece together what exactly is going on in this post apocalyptic world 



Created by MICHAEL GENE ACORD JR

Released by SINYSTER SOULUTIONS STUDIOS

CRITICAL FAILURE (FREE TO PLAY GAME) - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2610640/Critical_Failure/

CRITICAL FAILURE "NO MAN'S LAND" (PAY TO PLAY)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4200090/Critical_Failure_No_Mans_Land/
